core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mouhib corresponds to the Arabic form محب and is glossed in this record as “Lover, one who loves.” The record associates the form with root ح ب ب (ḥ-b-b). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mouhib corresponds to the Arabic form محب (Arabic root ح ب ب (ḥ-b-b); مُحِبّ (Muḥibb)). Its core sense is lover, one who loves. Mouhib is Arabic مُحِبّ (Muḥibb) 'lover, one who loves', from the root ح ب ب (ḥ-b-b). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave موهب (a non-standard form); the correct form is مُحِبّ. The source gloss 'Lover, Affectionate, Kind' is partly consistent.

persian.name: محب
persian.long_meaning: Mouhib (محب) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن محب، دوستدار است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: मुहिब
